key_insight: A single self-supervised Transformer encoder can learn consistent, transferable representations across widely different point-cloud domains (remote sensing, LiDAR, RGB‑D, CAD, and RGB‑lifted), bridging sensing geometries and densities.
problem_solved: Addresses the fragmentation of point-cloud models by removing the need for separate domain-specific encoders and enabling one pretrained model to generalize across diverse 3D data sources.
method: Train a unified Transformer-based point encoder with self-supervised objectives on a mixture of diverse point-cloud datasets spanning multiple domains.
Use domain-agnostic augmentations, sampling and representation strategies to cope with variations in geometry, density and sensor priors so embeddings are comparable across domains.
Evaluate transferability and robustness via downstream tasks (e.g., classification, segmentation, retrieval) to demonstrate cross-domain benefits.
impact: Enables practitioners to pretrain one versatile 3D encoder that reduces per-domain engineering, improves transfer learning and data efficiency, and simplifies deployment across heterogeneous point-cloud applications.

paper_title: Utonia: Toward One Encoder for All Point Clouds
paper_authors: Yujia Zhang, Xiaoyang Wu, Yunhan Yang, Xianzhe Fan, Han Li
